counts.description: occurrence records indexed under GBIF backbone taxonKey 2436436 at retrieval time

measurement_technique: Aggregate count of georeferenced and non-georeferenced occurrence records (specimens, observations, literature) indexed by GBIF under the backbone taxon and its descendants.
role: geographic distribution and sampling effort for Homo sapiens
notes: Human occurrence records in GBIF are mostly incidental (e.g. archaeological or museum specimens) and are not a distribution dataset in the usual sense.
